meta.title: Nexolume: offline Writer, Sheets and Slides
meta.description: A Windows office suite that keeps your documents on your computer. Writer, Sheets and Slides, with no account and no connection.

hero.title: Offline office suite.
hero.lead: Nexolume brings Writer, Sheets and Slides together in one Windows suite. No account, and your files stay on your PC.

writer.name: Writer
points: Comments and tracked changes kept in .docx and .odt.

mock.heading: Monday meeting notes
lines: The quarter's figures are in Sheets.
The presentation is waiting for the last screenshots.

sheets.name: Sheets
points: SUM, AVERAGE, MIN, MAX, COUNT and the + - * / operators.
Results recalculate as soon as a cell changes.
Selections and movement from the keyboard.

slides.name: Slides
points: Slides, shapes and text on one page.
A single undo step per drag.

items.title: Offline
items.text: No account to create, no connection: your documents are sent nowhere.

items.title: Compatible
items.text: Open and save Word and OpenDocument files, comments included.

items.title: No installer
items.text: A ZIP archive to extract, then Nexolume.exe. Nothing else on your system.

formats.title: Supported formats
formats.lead: Open and save, for each of them.

items.text: Word: text, styles, tables, images, comments and tracked changes.
OpenDocument: the same elements, with annotations and tracked changes.
Nexolume's native format, as versioned JSON.
Native workbook, with formulas and formats.
Native presentation, with slides and shapes.

formats.caveat: Advanced objects in Word files are kept when you save, but their display stays simplified.

limits.title: What is still missing
limits.lead: This is an alpha. Here is what it does not do.
items: Undo history is not kept after closing.
Advanced Word objects are displayed in simplified form.

steps.title: Download
steps.text: Get the ZIP archive of version 0.1.0-alpha.

steps.title: Extract
steps.text: Extract the whole ZIP before running the program.

cta.title: Your files, at home.
cta.text: Windows x64. The ZIP comes from this project's GitHub releases page.

footer.legal: Nexolume is a project under development. Version 0.1.0-alpha.
